items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Anderson said he think, that's until they come up with that hundred dollars.

ctx.x: They get back on the bar.

Yeah, you walk down and then you ride up. You ride up and then you finish up in the territory. So, Anderson said he think, that's until they come up with that hundred dollars. Anderson said he think he gonna give the, I have to call them up. Because they're the only one who got that hard job. The lions. The lions, yeah. Yeah. You see what then happened, a lot of young fellas, them youngsters, is taking the old man's place, the one who's died or the others in the club. And they taking over the children. And they…
Well, they must be newer. Well, the buzzers I know are the oldest. Huh? The buzzers are the oldest. I know they've been there longer than anybody.
